name: N4-erd-net

spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Implement clients/rust/erd-net — the complete transport layer. Four modules, TDD where seams exist.
DELIVERABLE:
1. tls_psk.rs — openssl crate (vendored feature) TLS client+server: external PSK callback (identity utf8 bytes, no null), identities 'erd-b1' (bootstrap) / 'erd-p1.<uuid>' (pairing), pin TLS1.2 PSK ciphersuites (TLS_PSK_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 / TLS_PSK_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384), min TLS1.2 max TLS1.3, verify callback always-true (PSK transcript is the auth). TLS1.3 PSK is KNOWN to fail on Apple stack — do not enable. Framing: 4B LE prefix + payload, 16MiB cap, partial-read state machine, oversized→drop.
2. udp_gcm.rs — AES-256-GCM datagram: plaintext 12B header + AEAD payload with AAD = header bytes; nonce 12B = 4B direction prefix + 8B BE counter; HKDF-SHA256 key chains byte-exact to spec (ikm 'erd/udp-ikm/v3', directions 'erd/udp-c2h/v3'/'erd/udp-h2c/v3', nonce suffix '/nonce'); 4096-packet sliding replay window with 64-block bitmask; unit tests ported from Swift CryptoProtocolTests (round-trip, tamper, AAD mismatch, duplicate, stale-outside-window, direction-keys-incompatible — port ALL 6).
3. signaling.rs — ntfy candidate exchange: topic 'erd3-'+hex(HKDF(ikm=pin, salt 'erd/signaling/v3', info 'erd/topic').prefix(14)), POST base64(AES-GCM(JSON candidate, key=HKDF(ikm=pin, salt 'erd/signaling/v3', info 'erd/payload-key'))), Content-Type text/plain, POST status check (non-2xx → error), poll GET /json?poll=1&since=10m at 1s to 10s deadline, JSONL parse .message, role filter, base64→AES-GCM open. Live test gated behind env ERD_LIVE_TESTS=1.
4. stun.rs — RFC5389 XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS against stun.l.google.com:19302, magic cookie, attribute parse.
SCOPE: contract = .omo/plans/tauri-client.md '## v3 Wire protocol spec'. Port test vectors from Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift (HKDF RFC5869 A.1/A.3, DatagramCipher round-trip/tamper/AAD/duplicate/stale/direction — all 6 cases) and ERDIdentity bootstrap-lockout semantics.
VERIFY: cargo test -p erd-net all green (PSK loopback test spins an in-process openssl PSK server thread); clippy -p erd-net clean.
STOP WHEN: transport complete, tests green, clippy clean.
NOTE: openssl vendored feature on macOS — add openssl-sys vendored feature to erd-net Cargo.toml for portability.

final_response:
I read this as completing the `erd-net` transport crate and proving it against the v3 contract - implementation and verification are complete.

Implemented:

- `tls_psk.rs`
  - OpenSSL vendored TLS client and server with PSK callbacks.
  - Bootstrap `erd-b1` and paired `erd-p1.<id>` identities.
  - PBKDF2-SHA256 plus HKDF bootstrap key derivation.
  - TLS 1.2 PSK AES-GCM cipher suites; TLS 1.3 negotiation disabled for Apple interoperability.
  - Always-true certificate verification callback.
  - Incremental 4-byte LE framing with 16 MiB limit and invalid-buffer drop.
  - Bootstrap failure lockout semantics.
  - In-process PSK server loopback and partial framing tests.

- `udp_gcm.rs`
  - AES-256-GCM datagrams with plaintext 12-byte authenticated headers.
  - Direction-separated HKDF key and nonce chains.
  - 4-byte prefix plus 8-byte BE counter nonces.
  - 4096-packet replay window using 64-bit block masks.
  - RFC 5869 vectors and all six Swift datagram tests, plus exact v3 derivation vectors.

- `signaling.rs`
  - Deterministic 33-character ntfy topic derivation.
  - AES-GCM encrypted, Base64 candidate publication.
  - Required candidate JSON field names and role filtering.
  - POST status validation and JSONL polling with 10-second deadline.
  - Live ntfy round-trip test gated by `ERD_LIVE_TESTS=1`.

- `stun.rs`
  - RFC 5389 binding requests with transaction validation.
  - XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS and MAPPED-ADDRESS parsing.
  - Attribute padding and malformed-response handling.
  - Default `stun.l.google.com:19302` endpoint.

- Added required dependencies, including direct `openssl-sys` with `vendored`.
